MAJOR: `ingest` subcommand path still writes review evidence via `_ingest` without invoking `review_guard`, so the disposition-before-re-review control and reasoned-override audit trail can be bypassed by ingesting an offline review file.

`review_churn_check` base resolution chains `ar._git_text(["merge-base","develop","HEAD"]) or ... "origin/develop"`; if `_git_text` raises on a missing ref (instead of returning ""), the documented `origin/develop` fallback is unreachable and the gate hard-errors on repos without a local `develop`.

`churn_verdict(...)` fail/over-budget state is computed in the guard path but never enforced or surfaced by `architect_review run` — a review run proceeds silently while over budget; only the separate gate catches it.
MINOR: `diff_reviews` counts archived `-prev-<ms>.json` files as distinct reviews (test asserts this), so a single logical review that is re-run inflates the churn count and can trip warn/fail for one freeze.

`--json` emits no JSON document when a scan error occurs (stderr text + exit 2 only), breaking machine consumers expecting a parseable result; error rows in valid `--json` output carry `warn_after:0/fail_after:0/fail:true`, which misreports the budget.

`review_guard` returns the redacted reason as the success payload, but `main` discards it and re-redacts `a.reason` separately — two independent redaction call sites where a future change to one silently desynchronizes the audit value.

Redaction is regex-heuristic; free-text pasted into `--reason` can carry secrets not matching the token patterns, and only the sha is required — consider an explicit "no raw credentials" assertion or hash-only storage beyond `rereview_reason_sha256`.

`_GROUP_OF["review-churn"]="backlog"` diverges from the sibling `architect-review` mapping to `"quality"`; if the group taxonomy in precheck doesn't define `backlog`, group filtering will behave inconsistently.
NIT: Pure formatting churn in `config/architect-review.json` (`blocking_findings`, `skip_globs` reflow) inflates the review diff with no semantic change.
`redact_reason` calls `review_budget()` (config read) on every invocation, including per-row paths; hoist the cap.
Archive filename uses `int(time.time()*1000)` — same-millisecond collision would silently overwrite a prior archived review; use a counter or the sha suffix.
`committed=True` path runs one `git show` per evidence file; fine at current scale but O(n) subprocesses if review counts grow.
SUMMARY: Solid single-owner design: thresholds/counting live only in `config/architect-review.json` via `review_budget()/churn_verdict()`, the gate and run guard both consume it, boundary/epoch/redaction/HIL/fail-closed semantics are tested, and docs state the policy — acceptance criteria are largely met.

Top risks: the `ingest` subcommand is an ungated write path around the disposition-before-re-review control; base-ref fallback likely doesn't deliver the documented `origin/develop` behavior; and over-budget state is not surfaced at review time.
Recommend closing the ingest bypass and hardening base resolution before relying on this as a Gate 2.5 control.
